Module com.example.sudoku_game
Package com.example.sudoku_game.model

Class GameStatus

java.lang.Object
com.example.sudoku_game.model.GameStatus
All Implemented Interfaces:
IGameStatus
public class GameStatus extends Object implements IGameStatus
Represents the current status of a Sudoku game session. This class implements IGameStatus and is responsible for tracking the number of mistakes made and hints used by the player during a game. It provides formatted strings for display in the user interface.
